content:
name: CI
on: [ pull_request ]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ ubuntu-latest, macOS-latest ]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Cache node modules
        id: cache-npm
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        env:
          cache-name: cache-node-modules
        with:
          path: ~/.npm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-build-${{ env.cache-name }}-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-build-${{ env.cache-name }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-build-
            ${{ runner.os }}-
      - name: build
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm run build
  test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ ubuntu-latest, macOS-latest ]
    needs: build
    steps:
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Cache node modules
        id: cache-npm
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        env:
          cache-name: cache-node-modules
        with:
          path: ~/.npm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-build-${{ env.cache-name }}-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-build-${{ env.cache-name }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-build-
            ${{ runner.os }}-
      - name: build
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm run build
      - name: test
        run: npm test
      - name: coverage
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
